rounds.text: Competent Automobiles Company Ltd exhibits chronically weak capital efficiency, as evidenced by a low return on equity (ROE) of 6.0% [E13], which is also flagged as a negative 6.72% over the last three years [E54] and triggered a bearish screen signal at 6% [E60]. This poor performance is further highlighted by a median ROE of 7% over three years [E20] and 6% over the last year [E21], falling far short of the sector benchmark ROE of 11.49% [E9]. Similarly, the company's return on assets (ROA) of 2.52% severely underperforms the sector benchmark of 5.98% [E8], while its return on capital employed (ROCE) of 8.2% [E12] lags behind both the sector benchmark of 12.54% [E10] and the sector median ROCE of 13.9% [E67]. Reflecting these fundamental struggles, market sentiment remains depressed with the stock sitting at just 25% of the way up its 52-week range [E5] and offering a minimal dividend yield of 0.29% [E4]. Conceded: [E1], [E2], [E6], and [E7] show that the company trades at low valuation multiples, including a P/E of 8.87 [E1] (or 10.07x against a sector benchmark of 26.57x [E6]) and a price-to-book ratio of 0.55x [E2] (or 0.56x against a sector benchmark of 2.93x [E7]).
